_comment: Read by codex (.codex-plugin/plugin.json) and by antigravity/agy, which reads
this file at the plugin root regardless of what a manifest points at.
${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} nor ${VAR:-default} — and hands the child no PLUGIN_ROOT
env var, so the previous ${PLUGIN_ROOT} form silently never launched. A
relative cwd DOES resolve against the installed plugin root, which is why the
invocation is expressed that way. See MCP-011 research finding 3.
Consequence: Node on PATH is a hard dependency for a codex plugin install —
no override can be expressed. Stated in FRD-012 R6. ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE is
harmless under plain Node and is kept for hosts that later gain expansion.
No --root: the server discovers the board from cwd (ADR-0012, MCP-010).
